assets.prompt: Revise this adri_especial animation skin. Input 1 is the ORIGINAL NORMAL character: identity, head proportions and professional front-facing animation reference. Input 2 is the APPROVED SKIN DESIGN to retain, but its pose registration and anatomy must be corrected. Inputs 3/4 are ORIGINAL WALK and HAPPY reference for the same base character. Keep the beige rib-knit beanie with burgundy monogram, cream quilted winter jacket with black side panels, black gloves, black trousers and black shoes. Deliver exactly a THREE-COLUMN TWO-ROW sprite sheet, 1536x1024, six 512x512 square cells with absolutely TRANSPARENT background. No dividers, labels, shadows, ground, scenery, particles or motion marks. Full silhouette in every cell. Maintain original clean ink contours and cel-shaded caricature illustration. The sheet will be flipped rapidly in a game, so precise registration matters more than dynamic illustration. Keep nose, eye line, skull, chin, neck and torso centre at IDENTICAL X and Y coordinates in every cell. Both eyes are equally visible at all times. Head and torso face exactly straight forward, perfectly upright, zero yaw/roll/lean, never three-quarter view. NEVER mirror, shift sideways, change scale, tilt, lean back, rotate shoulders or turn the body. Change only facial expression and small limb positions. Row-major order: NORMAL, MOVE1, MOVE2, SCARY1, SCARY2, HAPPY. Critical correction: reproduce the HUGE HEAD and SMALL BODY proportions of original reference 1, not reference 2. Head including hair/hat must occupy 58–60% of the character's total height, about 270px of a 448px silhouette; face/skull as wide as nearly twice the torso. In each 512px cell use centreline x=256, head top y=32, chin y=300, tiny torso y=300..384, short legs and feet ending at y=480. Keep face EXACTLY the original person's face, enlarged chibi eyes and original proportions. On walking frames ONLY alternate which foot is slightly forward and the opposite hand slightly forward, no crossing legs, no twisting, no moving the whole head or chest. SCARY1 widened eyes/open mouth with hands modestly out; SCARY2 slightly different frightened eyes/mouth and fingers, but head, shoulders and torso in exactly the same upright location. HAPPY broad joyful smile and one hand raised, head and torso still fixed and vertical. Same hair silhouette and eye centre across all cells, no motion graphics.
